review: R Corp Meursault is a tank that specialises in bleed count application who is also very fast. His clashing and damage are average, especially his Skill 3 needs the 10+ charge requirement to do anything. While he has Aggro and decent tank stats, his bleed count application is what sets him apart from other tank IDs that can take a hit way better than him. Notable E.G.O. Synergies Regret - Fixes R Meur clashing issues massively on top of boosting his damage a bit
